releaseNotes: Extension manifest schema v1 (id, version, entry point, capabilities, assist flag).
Capability broker with first-release adapters: source-control.read and build.execute.
TypeScript extension runtime executed out-of-process over stdio NDJSON IPC.
Dual error logging architecture (user-facing sanitized stream and developer verbose stream).
Internal DEBUG-only scaffolding: SDKConfigStore, DirectServiceAccess, TestHarness, SandboxBypass (stripped from release builds).
